problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 65 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 49 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 45 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 52 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 60 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 49 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 39 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
